verdict.rationale: Fathom's developer docs describe official TypeScript and Python SDKs. Each has its own installation page, and the SDKs are said to handle authentication, pagination and error handling. There is also SDK-level documentation for filtering and a webhook verification helper (Fathom.verifyWebhook). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs, and evidence of language coverage beyond TypeScript/Python or of versioning/package-registry details (the OpenAPI spec probe also returned 404).
